Detailed Description

Derived sampling and checking class used by CPHY Serial components to register layer wide checks.

Member Function Documentation

  function void
 svt_mipi_cphy_serial_forward_direction_err_check::new
 (  string err_check_name = "", bit reg_checks = 1, bit enable_checks = 1, bit enable_pass_cov = 0, bit enable_fail_cov = 1, svt_mipi_cphy_configuration cfg = null  ) 

CONSTRUCTOR: Create a new svt_mipi_cphy_serial_forward_direction_err_check instance.

err_check_name - A string that identifies this particular svt_err_check instance.

reg_checks - A bit that identifies whether or not the default checks associated with this sampling/checking class should be registered automatically.

enable_checks - A bit that identifies whether or not the default checks associated with this sampling/checking class should be enabled. This bit only has meaning if reg_checks is set to 1.

enable_pass_cov - A bit that identifies whether or not the PASS checks coverage should be enabled.

enable_fail_cov - A bit that identifies whether or not the FAIL checks coverage should be enabled.

cfg - CPHY configuration class handle.

  function void
 svt_mipi_cphy_serial_forward_direction_err_check::register_checks
 (  bit enable_checks = 1  ) 

This method is called by the constructor if the reg_checks parameter is set to 1.

enable_checks - A bit that identifies whether or not the checks that are registered by this function should be enabled or disabled.

Checks that, In Escape mode, LP TX-000 i.e. Final Bridge State of Escape Mode entry procedure (LP-111, LP-100, LP-000, LP-001, LP-000) gets completed within configured Escape Mode Silence Timeout Duration (i.e. ESCAPE_MODE_SILENCE_TIMEOUT).

 svt_err_check_stats  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_serial_forward_direction_err_check::sot_error_check

Check: Checks that Sync Word sequence should correspond to the defined '3','4','4','4','4','4','3' symbol sequence in SoT phase
  • This check is applicable when only LSB of Sync sequence is corrupted and synchronization can be achieved. Due to this , violation of this check will be reported as WARNING.
  • This check is applicable for SoT phase.

 svt_err_check_stats  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_serial_forward_direction_err_check::sot_error_in_data_phase_check

Check: Checks that Sync Word sequence should correspond to the defined '3','4','4','4','4','4','3' symbol sequence in DATA phase
  • This check is applicable when only LSB of Sync sequence is corrupted and synchronization can be achieved. Due to this , violation of this check will be reported as WARNING.
  • This check is applicable for DATA phase.
